name: CHARLTON, the Hon. Dr Andrew Henry George

headline.note: The official timeline identifies university, international-development, political-staff, Wesfarmers, AlphaBeta and Accenture roles, but does not establish substantive full-time status or exact boundaries for the potentially countable private-sector spells. University research, political staff, study, campaigning and elected office are excluded. Missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.role: Senior/Chief Economic Adviser and G20 Sherpa
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official biography gives 2008–2010 and identifies the senior adviser and G20 Sherpa roles. The Labor biography says he joined the new government in 2007; secondary reporting supplies December 2007–June 2010, but primary month-level appointment evidence was not located, so the record retains the frozen year precision. Exact appointment/payroll dates, hours and the LSE overlap remain unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Political staff employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.role: Corporate strategy; divisional CFO and General Manager, including Coles Liquor; later corporate-office role
career_spells.evidence_note: Frozen and event biographies give2010–2014: two years corporate strategy and two years operational CFO/general-manager roles, without exact subdivisions. ABAC release4November2013 names Coles Liquor Group General Manager.18August2014 report says he moved back to Wesfarmers corporate office. Coles and Wesfarmers roles are nested, not added twice. Exact payroll entities, boundaries, hours and leave unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Wesfarmers was privately controlled, but year-only dates and unproven full-time status do not support an exact headline duration.

career_spells.evidence_note: Frozen biography gives2015–2020. Employer release confirms2015 founding and Australian acquisition signing/closing27February2020, identifying founder/director Charlton. Acquisition remains an exact corporate milestone but is not proof of his individual last employment day. Singapore business was separately owned/managed and excluded. Personal hours, start/end and leave unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: Private control established; personal full-time interval unresolved. Removed unsupported day precision while retaining transaction evidence.

career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is supported, but no exact substantive full-time interval is established.

research_notes: The frozen official occupation extract provides the backbone of the timeline but only year-level boundaries and no working-hours evidence.
The AlphaBeta acquisition date is exact primary-employer evidence; it does not prove that every preceding or succeeding day was substantive full-time work.
Senior, founder and managing-director titles are not treated as proof of full-time hours.
Potential overlap among Oxford study, LSE research and the December 2007 government appointment remains explicit.

Systematic follow-up2026-10-01 added omitted BCG and Oxford work, unspecified early jobs and writing; identified LSE centre/UNDP duty station, university completion year and Coles divisional details. Repaired event source URL. Totals remain null because no substantive full-time personal interval was found.

Corrected unsupported personal day boundaries based solely on27February2020 acquisition. Exact transaction date retained in evidence; personalAlphaBeta/Accenture transition remains year-level. Neither title, company staffing nor early office arrival proves full-time work. Coles divisional roles belong within existing2010–2014 spell; two-year descriptions do not license exact split dates.

Searched institutional scholarship/college records, university publications, employer acquisition release, ABAC historical release, trade reporting, public interview/event biographies and first speech; LinkedIn profile returned999, other sources usable. BCG,Oxford and pre-Oxford jobs need primary appointment documents. Search homonyms include chemistry/laser/meteorology careers and must not be merged.

Further leads: Brasenose2005/2006 college reports identify John Hicks scholarship and doctorate under2005 records, but course transfer/award versus enrolment dates require careful reconciliation. Candidate endorsement appears in reporting by28March2022 whereas existing record says1April; exact formal appointment versus announcement needs resolution. No publication or report date promoted to employment start.
